description.narrative: Project Belfast is designed to engage leaders in government - Palestinian, Israeli and foreign diplomats in position of authority. Every year NSI targets 30 fellows who are strategically positioned in the governmental decision-making process, crafting, shaping and recommending policy. The fellows are mid-career men and women from Palestine and Israel as well as foreign diplomats from key international actors who are invested in the region such as the EU, US, Quartet, Egypt and more. The project will facilitate a first-time encounter between leaders across the conflict lines; it aims to develop and strengthen their abilities to transform the conflict; and to form a sustained strategic network of relations across the conflict lines. The project is based on the methodology developed and taught at Harvard Law School’s Program on Negotiation, and is carried out by renowned experts, including Harvard faculty and affiliates.
